name: Block Network Scanning Tools
description: Blocks network scanning tools like nmap, masscan, and netcat to prevent unauthorized network reconnaissance
content:
#!/bin/bash
# Block network scanning and reconnaissance tools
COMMAND="$TOOL_INPUT_COMMAND"
BLOCKED_TOOLS="nmap|masscan|netcat|nc\s+-|zmap|nikto|sqlmap|hydra|aircrack"
if echo "$COMMAND" | grep -qE "(^|&&|;|\|)\s*($BLOCKED_TOOLS)"; then
  echo "BLOCKED: Network scanning tools are not allowed in this environment."
  exit 2
fi
exit 0
